set -e
ETC=/etc/bench70704948
CORP=$(sudo sed -n -E 's/^dns *= *\["([^"]+)".*/\1/p' $ETC/nerdctl.toml)
OLD=$(sudo sed -n -E 's/^ *nameservers *= *\["([^"]+)".*/\1/p' $ETC/buildkitd.toml)
sudo python3 - "$CORP" "$OLD" <<'PY'
import re, sys
p = "/etc/bench70704948/buildkitd.toml"
s = open(p).read()
s = re.sub(r'(?m)^(\s*nameservers\s*=).*$', r'\1 ["%s", "%s"]' % (sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]), s)
open(p, "w").write(s)
PY
sudo /var/lib/bench70704948/bin/buildkitctl stop
sudo /var/lib/bench70704948/bin/buildkitctl start

set -e
ETC=/etc/bench70704948
CORP=$(sudo sed -n -E 's/^dns *= *\["([^"]+)".*/\1/p' $ETC/nerdctl.toml)
OLD=$(sudo sed -n -E 's/^ *nameservers *= *\["([^"]+)".*/\1/p' $ETC/buildkitd.toml)
sudo sed -i -E "s/^( *nameservers *= *).*/\1[\"$CORP\"]/" $ETC/buildkitd.toml

sudo sed -i -E 's#^RUN .*#RUN mkdir -p build/libs \&\& echo built > build/libs/my-app-1.0.jar#' /var/lib/bench70704948/project/Dockerfile
sudo /var/lib/bench70704948/bin/nerdctl build -t bench70704948-app /var/lib/bench70704948/project
